description: This file defines an interface 'ShoppingCartCalculationService' which declares methods for calculating total summary details for a shopping cart object, including price calculations for line items, subtotal, and total, based on different parameters like customer and store. It acts as a contract for implementing classes to provide shopping cart price calculation logic.

classes.name: ShoppingCartCalculationService
classes.description: Interface declaring methods for calculating various totals related to a shopping cart, to be implemented by concrete classes.

methods.name: calculate
methods.description: Calculates total summary for a shopping cart including price for line items, subtotal, and total based on customer, store, and language information. Throws ServiceException.
